resources.string: Allows the Soft Braille keyboard to work correctly when TalkBack is active by creating an area where touches are not intercepted by the screen reader.
To use this keyboard with TalkBack, you must enable \'Soft Braille Keyboard\' in Accessibility settings. This allows the keyboard to receive your touches while TalkBack is active.
